reasons: The Datadog query groups by {db}, but the candidate PromQL has no by-clause, so it averages across all databases into one series instead of one series per database.
The grouping label should be postgresql_database_name, the observed dataset label for the database. db_namespace is listed as absent in the dataset, so it cannot be used.
Quantity, unit and aggregation match: postgresql.backends is the OTel equivalent of postgresql.connections (number of backends, unit 1), and avg is the same aggregation.
Outcome translated is correct because an exact translation exists; the fix is to add by (postgresql_database_name) to the avg, with the $scope variable correctly dropped.
